description: Runs sibling and communication rule cards located in Sarvarth Chintamani (Brothers v15, v17, v24; Speech v29) and Jyotisha Fundamentals (10.1.1, 10.1.3, 3.2.4): Lagna lord friendship with the 3rd (younger) and 11th (elder) lords, benefic blessing of the 3rd, Mars rivalry and Mercury's condition for talking with kin. Each finding cites its rule card. No loss-of-sibling claims.
